what: The card row is redrawn as a screen-fixed WebGL plane, so card edges twist the opposite way (.32rad) by scroll speed (full at 40px/frame, following .1 per frame) and the middle sags like cloth (.14 × height). When a card reaches 92% of the screen a rolled paper unfurls from top to bottom (1.2s, cubic-bezier(.18,.66,.18,1)), and on interaction the touched spot is pressed in a Gaussian shape (depth .07 × height, .38s power3.out / on release .3s power2.inOut)

options.[data-fx-part=card]: Card to be redrawn flat — follows its position, size and corner radius (border-radius) exactly. If it is not an img, a label is baked in using this card’s background and text colors
options.[data-fx-part=photo]: Photo inside a card — if it is an img, that picture is used as the texture and hidden when GL is on (data-label is the label text)
options.twist · sag: Twist (rad) · sag (height ratio) when speed is full, default .32 · .14
options.roll: Unfold length (sec), default 1.2 — 0 means it is already unfolded from the start
options.speed: Scroll px per frame at full speed, default 40

note: Load three (global THREE) first: loading three-global.js before three.cjs makes it readable as window.THREE. One fixed full-screen canvas covers the cards, so text between cards (captions) needs a z-index higher than the canvas (2). The original turns the whole ribbon as one sheet, putting cards on the strip (toRibbon · sheet · lean), and even does the flight where cards fly out and spread when a work is opened. This part carries over only per-card twist · sag · curl · press as numbers with the same meaning

from.where: index.html .work__list .proj__card — original recent work ribbon (u_twist · u_sag · u_roll · u_dent, unfolds on entry, reveal 1.2s)
